claims.statement: Scheduled reminder concept declares FPT/GHEC, not GHES. Personal/team review requests apply within organizations user belongs to; organization owner must authorize Slack workspace before personal reminder creation.

Scheduled Slack messages surface open PRs needing review at configured time; 10AM example is not adopted schedule or delivery guarantee. Reminder is attention aid, not completed review, approval or merge enforcement.
Optional realtime alerts target important events triggered by another user. Source does not establish all actor/event coverage, delivery latency, deduplication or retry guarantees.

Shared limitation caps each reminder at five repositories, explicitly selected or automatically chosen by oldest average PR age; each shows up to20 oldest PRs. Limit is per configuration and repository owner, so omitted entities remain outside delivered list.
Additional configurations may cover more than five repositories per owner; source capability does not authorize recurring activation, Slack grants, costs or estate schedule changes.
Shared note excludes reminders when changes merge upstream into fork. Missing reminder cannot prove no pending review or compliant state; reminder denominator must remain separately inventoried.
Concept links setup and organization authorization guides as distinct review work. No Slack workspace authorized, scheduled process activated or actual notification delivery/behavior receipt claimed.
